idea_name: SQL join/alias tutorial for quote–symbol tables
mechanism: Educational SQLite walkthrough: FK between tb_Quotes and tb_Symbols, DBeaver ER diagram (one-to-many), Cartesian SELECT vs WHERE fk_id=id with table aliases, column aliases, ORDER BY price DESC, UPDATE via subquery on symbol name, and SELECT changes() to count rows touched by the last UPDATE. No market-state feature is computed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BOVA11, PETR4, WDOQ23, VALE3; daily of_day quote dates (e.g. 10–17 Jul 2023) in toy SQL inserts
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—SQL language/schema tutorial only.
quote: One of SQL's greatest strengths is that it lets us create tables that seem independent while still relating them—or, more precisely, relating the values stored in them.

idea_name: Position View indicator scaffold and chart-object priority
mechanism: Starts a chart-window indicator that PositionSelect(s) the chart symbol, prints ticket/open/SL/TP, then discusses wallpaper/object z-order and event priority when Chart Trade, mouse study, and future Order/Position indicators share the chart. Goal is cross-order and replay visual feedback, not a price/volume regime sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: generic MT5 chart symbol; replay/simulation RePlay context referenced; no TF-specific sensing
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—UI/architecture for position lines and object priority only.
quote: Especially when using the cross-order system… we are looking at the chart of the symbol we are observing. However, the order or trade request is placed on another symbol whose chart is not open.

idea_name: SQL FK integrity, cascading delete, and triggers
mechanism: Shows orphaned fk_id when FOREIGN KEY is omitted, blocked DELETE when FK is on, manual child-then-parent delete, BEFORE DELETE trigger using OLD.id to cascade quotes, AFTER INSERT/UPDATE triggers with NEW/OLD and upper(), and BEFORE UPDATE RAISE(ABORT) to freeze symbol names. Pure DB integrity pedagogy for the replay series.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: PETR4, ITUB3, VALE3, BBDC4; five daily quotes each (2023-07-10..14) in examples
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—relational SQL / trigger tutorial only.
quote: Code 01 DOES NOT CREATE A RELATIONAL DATABASE.

idea_name: HLINE open/SL/TP Position View with EnumPriority
mechanism: Adds EnumPriority (null/default/ChartTrade/Orders), draws OBJ_HLINE at POSITION_PRICE_OPEN/TP/SL named by ticket+suffix, sets OBJPROP_TEXT/TOOLTIP, makes open line non-selectable at ePriorityNull while SL/TP use ePriorityOrders. Single-position only; tested on real symbols for later replay use—display plumbing, not market sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: chart symbol with one open position; RePlay define present; hedging vs netting noted; no TF sensor
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—chart position-line visualization and click-priority rules only.
quote: This horizontal line, and let this be absolutely clear, only this line, must have the lowest possible priority… it represents the price or point at which the trading server indicates the open position.
